info.title: Vocobase Partner API
info.description: API for managing voice AI agents, documents, and calls on the Vocobase platform.

tags.name: Config
tags.description: Read and update partner configuration, webhook settings, and telephony credentials.

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Create, read, update, and delete voice AI agents.

tags.name: Voices
tags.description: List voice tiers, available voices, and stream preview audio for agent configuration.

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: Upload, manage, and delete knowledge base documents.

tags.name: Agent Documents
tags.description: Link and unlink documents to agents for knowledge base integration.

tags.name: Calls
tags.description: Initiate outbound calls and view call history.

tags.name: Phone Numbers
tags.description: Import DIDs, assign agents for inbound routing, and re-sync carrier Application bindings.

tags.name: Inbound Routing Policies
tags.description: Define pre-answer routing decisions for inbound calls before AI sessions are created.

tags.name: Telephony Connections
tags.description: Create, list, rename, and disconnect named V2 telephony connections.

tags.name: VoiceLink Management
tags.description: Manage VoiceLink reseller clients, DID mapping, and readiness sync.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Organize agents into projects. Every agent belongs to exactly one project.

tags.name: Dictionaries
tags.description: Speech-recognition dictionary CRUD and agent attachment.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: Browser-initiated WebRTC voice sessions for in-app voice agents.

get.description: Returns the current partner configuration including webhook endpoints, telephony setup, agent limits, and allowed voices/languages. Sensitive values are masked.

put.summary: Set or update the legacy default webhook URL
put.description: Legacy compatibility endpoint. Creates or replaces the reserved `default` webhook endpoint used by older integrations. A new webhook secret is generated on each call. New integrations should use `POST /config/webhooks` to create labeled endpoints.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL to receive webhook events.

200.description: Webhook configured successfully. The secret is shown only once.

data.message: Save this secret — it will not be shown again.

get.description: Lists all configured webhook endpoints for the authenticated partner. Secrets are never returned.

post.description: Creates a labeled webhook endpoint. Each enabled endpoint receives the same webhook events and signs requests with its own secret. The secret is returned once in this response and cannot be read again.

label.description: Partner-chosen endpoint label. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only; 1-31 characters.

url.description: HTTPS URL that receives webhook events.

enabled.description: Whether the endpoint should receive new webhook events.

201.description: Webhook endpoint created. Save the secret immediately.

secret.description: HMAC signing secret. Starts with `whsec_`. Returned only once.

data.label: prod
data.message: Save this secret — it will not be shown again.

409.description: Label already exists or endpoint limit reached.

patch.description: Updates an endpoint's label, URL, or enabled state. Disabled endpoints stop receiving new webhook events.

label.description: New endpoint label. The reserved `default` label cannot be assigned manually.

enabled.description: Whether this endpoint should receive new webhook events.

409.description: Another endpoint already uses the requested label.

delete.description: Deletes a webhook endpoint. Delivery attempts that were already created may still use the previous URL and secret, but the deleted endpoint stops receiving new events.

post.description: Generates a new signing secret for the endpoint. The new secret is returned once. Delivery attempts that were already created may still use the previous secret.

200.description: Webhook endpoint secret rotated. Save the new secret immediately.

secret.description: New HMAC signing secret. Starts with `whsec_`. Returned only once.

put.description: Stores encrypted Twilio credentials for outbound calling. All three fields are required.

from_number.description: Twilio phone number in E.164 format.

put.description: Stores encrypted MCube JWT token and executive number for outbound calling. Creates or updates the partner's default MCube telephony connection; for multiple named connections use POST /telephony/connections with provider "mcube".

exe_number.description: MCube executive number (4-15 digits, optional + prefix).

put.description: Stores encrypted Exotel credentials for outbound calling. All six fields are required. The `caller_id` must be an E.164 phone number that Exotel has provisioned for your account.

account_sid.description: Exotel Account SID (SID of your Exotel account).

caller_id.description: Exotel-provisioned phone number used as the caller ID, in E.164 format.

applet_id.description: Exotel Applet (flow) ID used to handle the call.

put.description: Stores encrypted Plivo credentials for outbound calling. All three fields are required. The `from_number` must be an E.164 phone number that Plivo has provisioned for your account.

auth_id.description: Plivo Auth ID (starts with `MA` for production accounts, `SA` for subaccounts).

from_number.description: Plivo-provisioned phone number used as the caller ID, in E.164 format. Must have Voice capabilities enabled.

put.description: Stores encrypted Vobiz credentials for outbound calling. All three fields are required. The `from_number` must be an E.164 phone number that Vobiz has provisioned for your account.

from_number.description: Vobiz-provisioned phone number used as the caller ID, in E.164 format.

put.description: Stores VoiceLink credentials for outbound calling. VoiceLink authenticates with a panel `username` and `password`; Vocobase logs in with these to obtain a short-lived access token (the password is stored encrypted and never returned). `username`, `password`, and `from_number` are required; `base_url` is optional and defaults to the VoiceLink API host. The `from_number` must be an E.164 number provisioned on your VoiceLink account and is stored as the connection's default outbound DID. Requires `"voicelink"` in `allowed_telephony_providers`.

password.description: VoiceLink panel password. Stored encrypted; never returned.

from_number.description: VoiceLink-provisioned number used as the caller ID, in E.164 format. Stored as the connection's default DID.

base_url.description: Optional VoiceLink API base URL. Omit to use the default host.

put.summary: Set or update Tata Smartflo credentials
put.description: Stores Tata Smartflo credentials for inbound and outbound BYOP WebSocket calling. Tata Smartflo authenticates with a panel `email` and `password`; Vocobase logs in with these to obtain short-lived API tokens (the password is stored encrypted and never returned). `email`, `password`, and `from_number` are required; `base_url` is optional and defaults to the Tata Smartflo API host. The `from_number` must be an E.164 DID returned by Smartflo `GET /v1/my_number` and is stored as the connection's default outbound DID. Requires `"tata_smartflo"` in `allowed_telephony_providers`.

password.description: Tata Smartflo panel password. Stored encrypted; never returned.

from_number.description: Tata Smartflo DID used as the caller ID, in E.164 format. Stored as the connection's default DID.

base_url.description: Optional Tata Smartflo API base URL. Omit to use the default host.

agent_number.description: Optional outbound agent leg number. Use only after Vocobase confirms the required Smartflo value for your account.

put.description: Changes the partner display name shown in the dashboard and API responses.

get.description: Lists active named telephony connections owned by the authenticated partner. Use the optional provider filter to narrow results.

post.description: Creates a named BYOP telephony connection. Store the returned `connection_id` and pass it to call-start or phone-number sync endpoints when a partner has multiple active connections for the same provider.

patch.description: Updates the display name of an active partner-owned telephony connection. Credentials are not rotated by this endpoint.

delete.description: Disconnects an active partner-owned telephony connection and inactivates its phone numbers.

post.summary: Map a VoiceLink DID to a client
post.description: Maps a VoiceLink DID to a VoiceLink client. VoiceLink remains the source of truth for remote DID ownership; Vocobase does not delete local phone-number rows when remote mapping changes.

Fetches remote VoiceLink clients, DIDs, available DIDs, bots, and routing, then compares them with Vocobase local PhoneNumber rows. By default, remote DIDs are imported into Vocobase local inventory; pass `import_dids: false` for a read-only readiness check. Sync does not silently delete local data.

post.description: Runs the safe outbound call-ready workflow for a purchased VoiceLink DID: import the DID into Vocobase if missing, optionally map an unmapped DID to an explicitly supplied `client_id`, ensure an active VoiceLink WebSocket bot for the mapped client, and ensure outbound routing points to that bot. Existing inbound routing is preserved on routing updates. DID mapping happens only with an explicit `client_id` and only when the DID is currently unmapped — a DID mapped to a different client is never re-mapped, and clients are never auto-created. This endpoint does not purchase, renew, run KYC, or allocate wallet credit. Pass `connection_id` when the partner has more than one active VoiceLink connection.

get.description: Lists WebSocket bots from the selected active VoiceLink connection. Pass `connection_id` when the partner has more than one active VoiceLink connection. Numeric filters are validated strictly: zero, negative, non-integer, or non-finite values are rejected with a 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` naming the field.

parameters.name: connection_id
parameters.description: Optional unless multiple active VoiceLink connections exist.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: VoiceLink bot status filter: 1 active, 0 inactive.

post.description: Creates a WebSocket bot in VoiceLink for a mapped client. When `websocket_url` is omitted, the bot points to the Vocobase Pipecat Cloud bot endpoint. This endpoint never purchases or renews DIDs, runs KYC, allocates wallet or credit, or deletes local Vocobase data. Numeric fields are validated strictly: zero, negative, non-integer, or non-finite values are rejected with a 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` naming the field.

Updates a WebSocket bot in VoiceLink. The VoiceLink update REPLACES the bot record, so resend every field you want kept — `bot_name`, `websocket_url`, and `status` are all required on update. This endpoint never purchases or renews DIDs, runs KYC, allocates wallet or credit, or deletes local Vocobase data.

get.description: Lists DID call-routing records from the selected active VoiceLink connection. Pass `connection_id` when the partner has more than one active VoiceLink connection.

parameters.name: connection_id
parameters.description: Optional unless multiple active VoiceLink connections exist.

post.description: Creates a call-routing record for a DID (one record per DID). Provide either `did_id` or `did_number`. `for_inbound_call` and `for_outbound_call` are VoiceLink mode integers; `3` routes to a WebSocket bot. For the common outbound case, prefer `POST /voicelink/call-ready`, which performs the same setup safely. This endpoint never purchases or renews DIDs, runs KYC, allocates wallet or credit, or deletes local Vocobase data. Numeric fields are validated strictly: zero, negative, non-integer, or non-finite values are rejected with a 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` naming the field.

Updates a call-routing record in VoiceLink. The VoiceLink update REPLACES the routing record, so resend every field you want kept — `for_inbound_call`, `for_outbound_call`, and `status` are all required on update, including the current inbound values if you only intend to change outbound routing. For the common outbound case, prefer `POST /voicelink/call-ready`, which preserves existing inbound settings automatically. This endpoint never purchases or renews DIDs, runs KYC, allocates wallet or credit, or deletes local Vocobase data.

get.description: Lists the partner's imported DIDs. Use `provider` or `connection_id` to filter the response. The returned phone number `id` is used by `PUT /phone-numbers/{id}` for agent assignment.

post.description: Imports DIDs into Vocobase for inbound routing. For Plivo, Vocobase pulls the inventory from Plivo REST using the selected connection's credentials. For Vobiz, pass an explicit `numbers` array because Vobiz inventory pull is not available. Vobiz uses `numbers`, not `phone_numbers`. Pass `connection_id` when the partner has multiple active connections for the provider.

connection_id.description: Optional unless multiple active Plivo connections exist.
Optional unless multiple active Vobiz connections exist.

numbers.description: Vobiz DIDs in E.164 format. This field is named `numbers`.

200.description: Sync completed. Plivo and Vobiz return different counters.

post.description: Re-applies the Vocobase answer/status Application binding to every assigned DID for the requested provider. Use this after rotating credentials, editing carrier-side settings directly, or validating that all assigned DIDs point back to Vocobase.

connection_id.description: Optional unless multiple active connections exist for this provider.

put.summary: Assign an agent to a DID
put.description: Updates a phone number's agent assignment, inbound-routing flag, friendly name, or status. Active duplicate DIDs are allowed for outbound caller ID reuse, but only one active row per DID can have `inbound_enabled=true`. When inbound routing changes for Plivo or Vobiz, Vocobase first updates the carrier Application binding and then updates the local record. If carrier sync fails, the local assignment is not committed.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to assign. Use `null` or an empty string to clear assignment. If `inbound_enabled` is omitted, assigning an agent enables inbound routing and clearing the agent disables it.

inbound_enabled.description: Whether this DID should receive inbound calls for the assigned agent. Set `false` to keep the row available for outbound caller ID use only.

409.description: The DID is already enabled for inbound routing on another active row.

error.message: A policy already exists for this phone number

get.description: Returns a paginated list of the partner's agents, ordered by creation date (newest first). Deleted agents are excluded.

post.description: Creates a new voice AI agent. The `voice_id` must be a voice ID from the voice catalog (see `GET /agent/voices`). Agent names must be unique per partner.

prompt.description: System prompt defining the agent's personality and behavior.

voice_id.description: Voice ID from the catalog returned by `GET /agent/voices`. The language and gender are taken from the selected voice.

agent_type.description: Whether the agent handles inbound or outbound calls.

intro_message.description: Optional greeting spoken when a call connects.

voicemail_detection_enabled.description: Per-agent toggle for carrier-side voicemail detection on supported outbound providers. Account-level provider support must also be enabled.

screener_handling_enabled.description: Per-agent toggle for phone screener handling on outbound calls. Requires `voicemail_detection_enabled` to be true and platform screener handling to be enabled.

voicemail_message.description: Optional message used after a supported carrier detects voicemail. Pass `null` or an empty string to clear.

project_id.description: Assign the agent to a specific project. Defaults to the default project if omitted.

enable_recording.description: Whether to record calls made with this agent.

kb_include_summaries.description: Include document summaries in KB search results.

kb_result_format.description: Custom format template for KB search results.

kb_enable_llm_processing.description: Enable LLM post-processing of KB search results.

kb_llm_system_prompt.description: System prompt for LLM KB processing.

end_call_enabled.description: Master toggle for the end-call tool. When false, the agent cannot end calls on its own regardless of `end_call_instructions`.

end_call_message.description: Farewell line spoken before the bot hangs up. When null/empty, a platform default is used.

end_call_instructions.description: Free-text natural-language instructions spliced into the system prompt under "When to end the call." Write your own conditions in plain English, e.g. "End the call when the caller says goodbye, has not spoken for an extended period, or asks to be removed from the list." When null/empty, the section is skipped entirely. Replaces the prior `end_call_triggers` enum array.

transfer_enabled.description: Master toggle for cold-transfer-to-human. `transfer_number` is required when true. When the agent transfers a call, Vocobase connects the caller to `transfer_number`. The session.completed webhook includes transfer metadata — see `data.call.transferred`.

transfer_number.description: E.164 number to transfer the call to. Required when `transfer_enabled` is true.

transfer_message.description: Announcement spoken before the transfer. When null/empty, a platform default is used.

transfer_instructions.description: Free-text natural-language instructions spliced into the system prompt under "When to transfer." Write your own conditions in plain English. When null/empty, the section is skipped. Replaces the prior `transfer_triggers` enum array.

user_idle_enabled.description: Controls whether the agent responds to caller silence using platform-managed idle settings. Defaults to true. When false, the bot will not ask if the caller is still there and will not end the call because of idle silence. Timeout and retry values are not configurable through V2.

extraction_enabled.description: Master switch for automatic post-call extraction. Defaults to true. When false, extraction is skipped after calls even if an `extraction_config` is later set (the config is preserved). The extraction schema itself is set via PUT /agent/{id} (`extraction_config`).

max_call_duration_secs.description: Hard cap on call duration in seconds. New agents default to 600 (10 minutes); pass `null` to disable the cap. Range 60-3600. At `(cap - 30s)` the bot speaks a soft "wrapping up" warning; at the cap it speaks the agent's farewell and gracefully ends the session through the standard end-of-call path.

background_audio_id.description: Reference to a `BackgroundAudio` asset (see `GET /agent/background-audio`) the bot will mix under its TTS for the duration of the call.

background_audio_volume.description: Mixing volume for `background_audio_id`. Range 0.0-1.0. When `null`, the bot applies a default of 0.3.

error.message: Agent limit reached. Maximum 10 agents allowed.

get.description: Returns a single agent by ID.

put.description: Updates one or more agent fields. Only provided fields are changed. At least one field must be provided.

voice_id.description: New voice ID from the catalog returned by `GET /agent/voices`. Updates language and gender to match the selected voice.

intro_message.description: New greeting message. Pass `null` or empty string to remove.

voicemail_detection_enabled.description: Toggle carrier-side voicemail detection for this agent on supported outbound providers.

screener_handling_enabled.description: Toggle phone screener handling for this agent on outbound calls. Requires `voicemail_detection_enabled` to be true and platform screener handling to be enabled.

voicemail_message.description: Update the message used after a supported carrier detects voicemail. Pass `null` or an empty string to clear.

project_id.description: Move the agent to a different project.

variables.description: List of pre-call variable names referenced in the prompt or greeting as `{{name}}`. Per-call values are supplied via the `variables` body field on `POST /calls/start`. Pass `null` to clear.

extraction_config.description: Custom Analysis config — runs an LLM extraction over the transcript after every completed call. Pass `null` to remove the config entirely. To pause extraction while keeping the config, use `extraction_enabled: false` instead.

extraction_enabled.description: Master switch for AUTOMATIC post-call extraction. Defaults to true. When false, extraction is skipped after calls even if `extraction_config` is set — the config is preserved, not deleted. Manual replay (`POST /calls/{call_id}/extract`) ignores this flag and runs as long as a config exists.

end_call_enabled.description: Toggle the agent's ability to end the call autonomously.

end_call_message.description: New farewell line. Pass `null` or empty string to fall back to the platform default.

end_call_instructions.description: Replace the free-text end-call instructions. Pass `null` or empty string to clear the section (the agent can still end calls via prompt logic if `end_call_enabled` is true). Replaces the prior `end_call_triggers` enum array.

transfer_enabled.description: Toggle cold transfer. When false, transfer settings are cleared.

transfer_number.description: E.164 destination number. Required when `transfer_enabled` is true.

transfer_message.description: New announcement spoken before transferring. Pass `null` or empty string for the platform default.

transfer_instructions.description: Replace the free-text transfer instructions. Pass `null` or empty string to clear the section. Replaces the prior `transfer_triggers` enum array.

user_idle_enabled.description: Toggle caller-silence follow-up for this agent. Defaults to true on new agents. Set false to prevent the bot from asking if the caller is still there or ending the call due to idle silence. Timeout and retry values remain platform-managed.

max_call_duration_secs.description: Update the hard call-duration cap. Range 60-3600. Pass `null` to remove the cap. New agents default to 600 (10 minutes); existing agents created before the default landed may currently hold `null`.

background_audio_id.description: Set or change the background-audio asset. Pass `null` to remove background audio.

background_audio_volume.description: Mixing volume override for `background_audio_id`. Range 0.0-1.0. Pass `null` to use the default (0.3).

error.message: An agent with this name already exists

delete.description: Soft-deletes an agent and removes all linked document associations. Related knowledge-base cleanup is handled asynchronously.

get.description: Returns every background-audio asset visible to this partner — both platform-curated (`is_platform: true`) and the partner's own uploads. Each row includes a 15-minute presigned `preview_url` for in-browser playback.

post.description: Step 1 of the two-step upload: returns a 15-minute presigned PUT URL plus the `id` of a new upload. Then PUT the WAV bytes directly to `upload_url` with `Content-Type: audio/wav`, then call `POST /agent/background-audio/{id}/finalize`.

slug.description: Stable identifier; unique across all assets.

mime_type.description: Must be `audio/wav` — only WAV is accepted in v1.

upload_url.description: Presigned PUT URL valid for 15 minutes.

error.message: slug already in use

post.description:
Step 3 of the upload: Vocobase validates the just-uploaded WAV file and either marks the asset `READY` (with detected `duration_secs`, `sample_rate`, `channels`) or `FAILED` with a human-readable error.

**Validation rules:**
- WAV (RIFF/WAVE) container, PCM or IEEE float.
- **Mono only** (channels === 1). Stereo is rejected with an explicit downmix hint.
- Size ≤ 5 MB. Duration ≤ 5 minutes.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the asset and detaches it from any agents currently using it (`background_audio_id` cleared).

get.description: Returns the voice catalog. Each voice has a tier (`va-1` or `va-1-pro`) that determines the per-minute rate at billing time. Pass the row's `id` as `voice_id` when creating or updating an agent. If `tier` is provided, it must be one of the tiers returned by `GET /agent/voice-tiers`.

get.description: Returns every speech-recognition dictionary owned by the partner, ordered by creation date (newest first). The summary shape does not include the `terms` array -- fetch a single dictionary to see them.

post.description: Creates a new speech-recognition dictionary for the partner. Terms are normalized server-side: whitespace is trimmed, empty/whitespace-only entries are dropped, non-string entries are silently skipped, and the dedupe is case-insensitive but preserves first-occurrence casing. A blank `description` is stored as `null`. Dictionary names must be unique per partner.

description.description: Optional description. Blank strings are stored as null.

terms.description: Optional list of terms. Defaults to []. Normalized server-side.

example.description: Product names, SKUs, and plan tiers referenced on support calls.

If the dictionary is attached to any agent and the new `char_count` would push that agent over 10,000 combined characters, the request fails with `DICTIONARY_CHAR_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`.

get.description: Returns all documents linked to an agent, including their sync status.

post.description: Links one or more documents to an agent for knowledge base integration. Documents must be in `ready` status. Duplicate links are silently skipped (idempotent). Maximum 20 document IDs per request, 100 total linked documents per agent. Indexing starts for newly linked documents.

document_ids.description: Array of document IDs to link.

skipped.description: Document IDs that were already linked.

put.description: Idempotent set-replace: overwrites the agent's entire dictionary set with `dictionary_ids`. Duplicate ids are deduped silently. Every id must exist and belong to the calling partner, else the whole request fails with `VALIDATION_ERROR`. The combined `char_count` across the resulting set must be at most 10,000 characters; otherwise the request fails with `DICTIONARY_CHAR_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`. Pass `[]` to detach all dictionaries. The swap is wrapped in a transaction -- the attached set is never briefly partial.

post.description: Initiates an outbound phone call via MCube, Twilio, Exotel, Plivo, Vobiz, Tata Smartflo, SIP, or VoiceLink. Requires sufficient credits and available call concurrency; use `GET /calls/concurrency` to inspect current capacity before starting a call. The provider you pass must appear in the partner's `allowed_telephony_providers` list and its credentials must already be configured. For non-MCube providers, pass `connection_id` when the partner has multiple active connections for the same provider. Provider-only calls remain backward compatible when exactly one active connection exists for that provider. Pass `from_number` to choose the caller ID for this call: it must be an active phone number owned on the selected connection (it overrides the agent-bound or default number for Twilio, Plivo, Vobiz, Tata Smartflo, VoiceLink, and SIP; MCube and Exotel caller IDs are fixed, so a differing `from_number` returns 400). When omitted, the caller ID is the agent-bound number where supported, otherwise the connection default. The resolved caller ID is returned as `from_number` in the response. The call is placed asynchronously. Use `call.status.updated` webhooks or `GET /calls/{id}` to track live status, and use `session.completed` for final transcript, recording, billing, variables, and extraction data.

to_number.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format.

provider.description: Telephony provider. Defaults to `mcube` if not specified. The provider must be in your partner's `allowed_telephony_providers` list and its credentials must be configured.

connection_id.description: Telephony connection ID to use for this call. Required when multiple active connections exist for the selected non-MCube provider. This is how you select which configured `from_number`/DID set should place the call.

from_number.description: Optional per-call caller ID in E.164 format. Must be an ACTIVE phone number owned on the selected connection (`connection_id` picks the connection; `from_number` picks the number within it) -- an unknown number returns 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, never a silent substitution. Overrides the agent-bound/default number for Twilio, Plivo, Vobiz, VoiceLink, and SIP. MCube and Exotel use a fixed caller ID, so any differing value returns 400. For VoiceLink, the DID should be call-ready (mapped and routed) or the carrier may reject the call. `fromNumber` is accepted for backwards compatibility.

variables.description: Pre-call variable values. Keys must match variable names declared on the agent (`Agent.variables`). Substituted into the agent's prompt and greeting via `{{name}}` placeholders. Echoed in the `session.completed` webhook for partner-side audit. Missing variables render as empty strings.

get.description: Returns the authenticated partner account's current phone-call capacity. The limit is resolved as: partner override (`maxConcurrentCalls > 0`) caps the account at that value; partner `maxConcurrentCalls = 0` means unlimited (no cap), in which case `limit` and `remaining` are `null` and `limit_source` is `partner_unlimited`. Active calls are counted from `pending`, `ringing`, and `in_progress` phone-call rows.

remaining.description: Available slots before the account reaches capacity. `null` when the partner is unlimited.

Mints a freshly signed download URL for the call's recording, valid for 7 days. Use this when the `recording_url` returned by `GET /calls/{id}` or by the `session.completed` webhook has expired.

Returns 404 if the call has no recording, the call is not yet complete, or the recording file is no longer available.

post.description:
Re-runs post-call extraction against an existing session's stored transcript using the agent's CURRENT `extraction_config`. Useful after editing the config to backfill old sessions, or to test a config against real conversation data.

- `dry_run: true` — runs extraction, returns values, does NOT persist or re-fire the partner webhook
- `dry_run: false` (default) — persists to the session's `extraction` field; partner webhook is **not** re-fired.

Returns 400 when the agent has no `extraction_config` defined. Subject to the same partner rate-limit as `POST /calls/start`.

post.description:
Transfers an active in-progress call to a human phone number via Plivo. The bot announces the transfer, then Plivo bridges the caller directly to the destination number. The call's `session.completed` webhook will include transfer metadata when the full call ends.

If `to` is omitted, the agent's configured `transfer_number` is used. The agent must have `transfer_enabled: true`.

post.description:
Creates a browser voice session and returns a room URL plus a one-time access token your browser uses to connect to the agent in real time.

The session is fully tracked on the platform — when the session ends, the same `session.completed` partner webhook fires (transcript, recording_url, extraction). The webhook payload's `call` field is omitted for these sessions because there is no associated phone call. See [Web Voice Testing](/web-voice-testing) for end-to-end browser integration code.

**Auth + limits:** Bearer API key (`rg_live_*`). Bound by the API key's concurrency limit. Rate-limited to 10 starts/minute per key.
